title: Tax-Return Allowance on a Patient Financial Assistance Program Documents Request
content:
**Rule.** On a documents request under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, a tax-return allowance is added to the response days by the tax returns received for the case: a case with no federal tax return received adds the no-return days, 12 days; a case whose most recently received tax return is for a tax year that ended more than 12 months before the application date, counted in whole calendar months, adds the stale-return days, 10 days; any other case adds none.

**Reading the return.** The tax year's end is the date on the return as received for the case. The months are whole calendar months from that date to the application date.

## Dated cases (hypothetical; tax year ended 31 December 2025)

| Application date | Whole calendar months from the tax year's end | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 15 September 2026 | 8 | None |
| 15 January 2027 | 12 | None: not more than 12 |
| 15 February 2027 | 13 | 10 days |
| Any date, no federal tax return received for the case | Not applicable | 12 days |

Where several tax returns have been received, the most recently received return is the one read.
